summary: New feature: bulk Print Tags page (/print-tags) with A6/A7/A8 size select, copies-per-item input, cutting-guides toggle, URL-persisted controls, and true-mm PriceTag rendering; legacy single-item /tag/{id} preview kept unchanged. Pure UI/state feature with no new API endpoints, so coverage is 7 named browser checks (one per acceptance-matrix criterion) plus a full backend regression run. All 7 browser checks passed on first attempt (one guides-toggle check needed a one-line selector fix from data-state to aria-checked, then passed). Backend suite: 80/83 passed; 3 pre-existing failures are unrelated to this feature and already documented in iterations 19-23 (appraise live-model fixture + shared Chiswick seed-flag residue from older test runs).

checks.criterion: Print Tags page offers A6, A7, A8 as tag sizes with A8 as the default
checks.name: print-tags-size-options-default-a8
checks.evidence: Logged in as master, picked 3 non-electrical inventory ids via /api/inventory, visited /print-tags?ids=.... print-size-select trigger showed 'A8' by default; opened select -> exactly 3 options (print-size-option-A6/A7/A8) visible, print-size-option-A9 count=0, total option count=3.

checks.criterion: Changing the tag size re-renders the grid at the correct cols-per-row for that size
checks.name: print-tags-size-changes-grid-cols
checks.evidence: 3 items, copies=1. Default A8: print-tags-grid data-tag-size='A8' data-tag-cols='4', 3 price-tag tiles. Switched to A6: data-tag-size='A6' data-tag-cols='2', 3 tiles. Switched to A7: data-tag-size='A7' data-tag-cols='2', 3 tiles. Back to A8: data-tag-cols='4', 3 tiles.

checks.criterion: Each printed tag renders at its true physical size in millimetres
checks.name: print-tags-true-mm-dimensions
checks.evidence: For size=A6/A7/A8 in turn, first price-tag's inline style.width/height read exactly '105mm'/'148mm', '74mm'/'105mm', '52mm'/'74mm' respectively, and data-tag-size matched the URL param each time.

checks.criterion: Copies-per-item multiplies the number of tiles rendered
checks.name: print-tags-copies-multiplies-tiles
checks.evidence: At ids(3)&size=A8&copies=1 -> 3 price-tag tiles. Filled print-copies-input='2' -> 6 tiles (toHaveCount assertion). Confirmed input has max='16' min='1' attributes. Cleared input to empty -> treated as 1, back to 3 tiles.

checks.criterion: Cutting-guides toggle adds dashed borders to each tile and the header summary updates sheet count
checks.name: print-tags-guides-toggle-and-sheet-summary
checks.evidence: print-sheet-summary showed '3 tags on 1 A4 sheet' for 3 items/A8/copies=1. print-guides-toggle defaulted aria-checked='false' and first tile's style.border had no 'dashed'. After toggling on (aria-checked='true'), every price-tag's style.border contained 'dashed'. Switching size to A6 with copies='3' (9 tags, 4/sheet) updated summary to '9 tags on 3 A4 sheets'.

checks.criterion: URL params persist the chosen controls so a reload keeps state
checks.name: print-tags-url-persists-on-reload
checks.evidence: Ran against public preview URL https://thrift-vision.preview.emergentagent.com. Set size=A7, copies=3, guides on via controls; URL matched /size=A7/, /copies=3/, /guides=1/. After page.reload(), print-size-select still showed 'A7', print-copies-input still '3', print-guides-toggle still aria-checked='true'.

checks.criterion: Legacy TagPage single-item preview still renders the fixed-width (non-sized) layout
checks.name: tag-page-legacy-preview-unsized-layout
checks.evidence: Visited /tag/{id} as master. price-tag element had no data-tag-size attribute, empty inline style.width (no mm value), and className included 'w-[340px]' (legacy fixed layout). tag-price, tag-barcode (>5 barcode rects) and tag-qr all visible.

action_items.detail: Full backend suite (83 tests) still has the same 3 pre-existing failures unrelated to this iteration's print-tags work, carried over from iterations 19-23: test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py::test_appraise_with_real_image_returns_valid_appraisal and test_tscheck_appraise_robustness_and_gating.py::test_appraise_returns_200_three_times_in_a_row (missing live-model /tmp fixture image), and test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py::test_shops_seeded_with_14_known_branches (Chiswick High Road's needs_zone_review flag flipped to false by earlier test residue, not by anything in this iteration). No action needed from this feature's code.
